summary: This bill directs the Secretary of Health and Human Services to establish a working group to develop recommendations for standardizing how loneliness and isolation are measured, aiming to improve research, public understanding, and healthcare tools.

scores.thoughts: This bill establishes a working group within the Department of Health and Human Services to standardize measurements of loneliness and isolation, explicitly mentioning their use in healthcare and involving various health agencies. This directly relates to public health research and understanding health determinants.
